name: Pagos Fiable-Transferencia Bancaria
author: Pagos Fiable

sections.description:
WooCommerce bank transfer payment gateway. Pagos Fiable automates transfer verification and improves checkout experience and trust.

Features

Transfer Specialized: Optimized for deposit and bank transfer workflows.

Native Integration: Works perfectly within the WooCommerce ecosystem.

Advanced Security: Encrypted processing and transaction validation via the Pagos Fiable API.

Status Management: Automatic order status updates upon confirmation.

Intuitive Dashboard: Quick and clear configuration for administrators.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin uses Bootstrap (https://getbootstrap.com/)
License: MIT
Source: https://getbootstrap.com/

External services

This plugin connects to an external API to process and validate bank transfer payments.

When a customer places an order using the bank transfer payment method, the plugin sends payment and order data such as order ID, amount, customer name, and transaction reference.

This service is provided by Pagos Fiable:

  • Terms of use: https://pagosfiable.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://pagosfiable.com/privacy
sections.installation:
Download the plugin ZIP file.

Upload the plugin to your WordPress site via the Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin menu.

Activate the plugin once the upload is complete.

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.

Locate Pagos Fiable (Transfers) and click “Manage”.

Enter your API credentials obtained from the Pagos Fiable portal.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pagos Fiable account?

Yes. You must register an account to obtain your API credentials.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Where do I get my API keys?

From your user panel on Pagos Fiable.
